title: Sensor user functions for the kinetic, potential and total energy of the system
author: Claude-JG
description: revision2026c step RG4.25.3 (maintainer 2026-10-15, with the drift of #565): SensorUFSystemKineticEnergy, SensorUFSystemPotentialEnergy, SensorUFSystemTotalEnergy for SensorUserFunction, like SensorUFSystemConstraintDrift; SystemEnergy(mbs).AddSensor() exists and records all four values, built once per model - the functions would build what they need per call or keep it per mbs
releaseNotes: exudyn.systemUtilities: the functions of a whole system - SystemEnergy and SystemConstraintDrift (derived from SystemQuantity) with Compute(), ComputeItems() and AddSensor(components=...), LoadPotentialEnergy, NumericalJacobian, ComputeConstraintResiduals, ComputeSystemGraph (the graph without drawing) and DrawSystemGraph; included in exudyn.utilities. SystemEnergy.ComputeSystemEnergies() is Compute(); CreateLoadEnergySensor and SensorUFSystemConstraintDrift are removed (use SystemEnergy(mbs, items=[load]).AddSensor(components=['loads']) and SystemConstraintDrift(mbs).AddSensor())
